trivia: Apex Legends launched on February 4, 2019.
The original roster had 8 Legends: Bangalore, Bloodhound, Caustic, Gibraltar, Lifeline, Mirage, Pathfinder and Wraith.
Octane was the first Legend added after launch, arriving in Season 1.
Kings Canyon was the very first Apex Legends map.
Apex Legends is set in the same universe as Titanfall.
Apex Legends is developed by Respawn Entertainment.
"Mozambique here" became one of the most recognizable jokes in the Apex community.
A giant Nessie has appeared as an easter egg in Apex.
Apex has used fake websites, hidden messages and encrypted clues as part of its storytelling.
Apex Legends reached 10 million players within its first few days.
Apex Legends reached 50 million players within its first month.
Apex Legends uses the same wider universe as Titanfall but takes place years later.
Apex Legends was developed in secret before its surprise release.
Apex Legends was revealed and released on the same day.
Apex's ping system became influential enough that similar systems appeared in many other multiplayer games afterward.
Apex's story takes place while players are repeatedly participating in an in-universe entertainment spectacle.
Ash contains traces of more than one personality inside her mind.
Ash has a rare Heirloom animation where she feeds her rat cheese.
Ash has another rare Heirloom animation involving a message from Pathfinder.
Ash keeps a pet rat.
Ash was once human before becoming a Simulacrum.
Ashleigh Reid was involved with Horizon long before Ash became a Simulacrum.
Bangalore spent years believing her brother Jackson was dead.
Bangalore's Heirloom is a combat knife named Cold Steel.
Bloodhound named their raven after their uncle Artur.
Bloodhound views hunting as something deeply connected to honor and tradition.
Bloodhound's Heirloom is an axe named Raven's Bite.
Bloodhound's raven is named Artur.
Broken Moon takes place on Cleo, the shattered moon of Boreas.
Catalyst grew up on Boreas and later worked on its damaged moon, Cleo.
Caustic entered the Apex Games partly because it gave him access to human test subjects for his research.
Caustic has a complicated connection to Wattson and sometimes acts almost paternal toward her.
Caustic named his poisonous gas after himself: Nox Gas.
Caustic's real name is Alexander Nox.
Certain voice lines only play when specific pairs of Legends interact.
Characters can insult, flirt with, apologize to or threaten one another through contextual dialogue.
Characters who hate each other in the lore can still be placed on the same squad.
Conduit uses technology powered by material connected to a damaged Titan battery.
Crypto became a fugitive after discovering information he was never supposed to see.
Crypto entered the Apex Games while hiding his true identity.
Crypto has been especially associated with secret messages and hidden codes throughout Apex's history.
Crypto joined the Apex Games partly because it gave him access to the people and systems he was investigating.
Crypto was framed for a crime he did not commit.
Crypto's drone is named Hack.
Crypto's real name is Tae Joon Park.
Despite being competitors, many Legends know each other personally outside the Games.
E-District is located in the city of Suotamo on Gaea.
Early Apex prototypes looked dramatically different from the final game.
Every Legend has unique voice lines when interacting with certain other Legends.
Fuse and Mad Maggie eventually became bitter enemies despite growing up together.
Fuse and Mad Maggie were childhood friends.
Fuse has a mechanical arm.
Fuse lost an arm during a violent argument with Mad Maggie.
Fuse's mechanical arm can launch explosives.
Future story developments have sometimes been teased months before players understood what the clues meant.
Gibraltar entered the Apex Games partly to protect people he cared about.
Horizon and Ash have one of the oldest personal connections between playable Legends.
Horizon became stranded near a black hole, causing decades to pass elsewhere while she experienced far less time.
Horizon returned home expecting to see her son again, only to discover that he had grown old and died long ago.
Horizon's real name is Dr. Mary Somers.
Jackson took over the Newcastle identity to protect his family and community.
Kings Canyon contains massive creatures called Leviathans.
Kuben Blisk appeared in Titanfall before playing a major role in Apex lore.
Kuben Blisk is closely associated with the creation and promotion of the Apex Games.
Legend relationships have changed over time as the story has progressed.
Legend-specific areas often contain references to that character's backstory.
Legends are celebrities inside the Apex universe, not just anonymous fighters.
Lifeline comes from a wealthy family despite dedicating herself to humanitarian work.
Lifeline helped Octane get his prosthetic legs after his accident.
Lifeline rejected much of what her wealthy family represented.
Loba dedicated much of her life to getting revenge on Revenant.
Loba deliberately prevented Revenant from getting the death he wanted as part of her revenge.
Loba has an Heirloom animation involving Revenant's severed head.
Loba is an expert thief as well as an Apex competitor.
Loba once tried to destroy the source responsible for Revenant repeatedly returning to life.
Loba uses teleportation technology built into her bracelet.
Loba watched Revenant kill her parents when she was a child.
Mad Maggie was once sentenced to fight in the Apex Games as punishment.
Many Apex characters have direct family or personal connections to major Titanfall events.
Mirage can occasionally attack someone with a pork chop while holding his Heirloom.
Mirage frequently uses jokes to hide his insecurity and fear.
Mirage originally struggled financially before becoming famous through the Apex Games.
Mirage owns a bar called the Paradise Lounge.
Mirage uses holographic technology connected to research performed by his mother.
Mirage's Heirloom is a trophy of himself.
Mirage's mother suffers from memory problems and sometimes struggles to remember him.
Mirage's real name is Elliott Witt.
MRVN stands for Mobile Robotic Versatile eNtity.
Nessie originally comes from a running joke and easter egg tradition at Respawn.
Nessie plushies are hidden throughout several Apex maps.
Newcastle entered the Games while secretly pretending to be someone else.
Newcastle is actually Bangalore's brother, Jackson Williams.
Octane and Lifeline knew each other long before either of them joined the Apex Games.
Octane comes from the powerful Silva family.
Octane lost both of his legs after using a grenade to launch himself across the finish line of a stunt.
Octane's butterfly knife contains a syringe filled with Stim.
Octane's father is closely tied to major political events in the Outlands.
Olympus is a massive floating city rather than a normal land-based city.
One development name used for Apex was "Apex Predator."
One of Wattson's animations involves a Nessie plush.
Parts of Apex's story are told through tiny environmental details hidden around the maps.
Pathfinder calls many people his "best friend," even when they clearly do not feel the same way.
Pathfinder is an MRVN robot.
Pathfinder spent years trying to discover who created him.
Pathfinder was created for a mission far more important than simply competing in the Apex Games.
Pathfinder's Heirloom boxing gloves have screens that display different expressions.
Pathfinder's unusually cheerful personality is intentional despite the violence surrounding the Apex Games.
Prowlers existed in the Titanfall universe before appearing in Apex Legends.
Rampart and Mirage have lived together.
Rampart became famous as a talented weapons modder before joining the Apex Games.
Rampart has a habit of putting her signature branding on weapons she modifies.
Rampart has repeatedly teased Mirage about his personality and intelligence.
Rampart is one of the few Legends who personally builds and modifies much of her own equipment.
Rampart named her mounted minigun Sheila.
Respawn decided that Titans were too powerful to fit the kind of combat they wanted Apex to have.
Respawn experimented with much larger numbers of players during development.
Respawn has hidden teasers for future characters inside maps before officially revealing them.
Revenant actually wanted Loba to destroy his source code so he could finally die.
Revenant eventually became aware of every death he had previously been programmed to forget.
Revenant has died many times because his consciousness can be placed into replacement bodies.
Revenant spent years believing he was still human because his programming hid the truth from him.
Revenant was once human before his consciousness was placed inside a robotic body.
Revenant's realization that he was not human helped drive him completely over the edge.
Seer was born during an event connected to the destruction of Boreas' moon.
Seer was considered cursed by some people because of the unusual circumstances surrounding his birth.
Several Apex weapons originally appeared in Titanfall games.
Some character relationships can be followed almost entirely through changing voice lines.
Some early Apex builds still contained Titanfall-style mechanics.
Some Legends have completely different dialogue depending on their current relationship in the story.
Some Legends joined the Games for fame while others entered for revenge, money, answers or survival.
Some map changes are actually major story events rather than simple visual redesigns.
Storm Point is located on the planet Gaea.
The Alternator existed in Titanfall 2 before Apex Legends.
The Apex Games are essentially a televised bloodsport inside the game's universe.
The Apex Games have moved between planets instead of remaining in one permanent arena.
The Apex Predator mercenary group from Titanfall is connected to the name of Apex's highest competitive rank.
The CAR SMG existed in Titanfall before Apex Legends.
The Flatline existed in Titanfall 2 before Apex Legends.
The flying creatures seen around Kings Canyon are called Flyers.
The game has included several references to Nessies, small plush creatures that became a recurring Respawn mascot.
The game reached one million players only hours after launch.
The game was originally prototyped under the name "Survival."
The human identity connected to Ash is Dr. Ashleigh Reid.
The Kraber existed in Titanfall before Apex Legends.
The Kraber is named after Titanfall weapon designer Eric Kraber.
The L-STAR existed in Titanfall 2 before Apex Legends.
The Legends record thousands of contextual voice lines for items, locations, teammates and story events.
The Mastiff existed in Titanfall 2 before Apex Legends.
The Mozambique existed in Titanfall before becoming one of Apex's biggest memes.
The original Newcastle was not actually Jackson Williams.
The Outlands contain dozens of planets and settlements beyond the maps players actually visit.
The Paradise Lounge has appeared repeatedly in Apex lore.
The Peacekeeper fires pellets in a distinctive star-shaped pattern.
The ping system was built so players could communicate effectively without needing a microphone.
The R-301 belongs to the same fictional weapon family as Titanfall's R-101 and R-201 rifles.
The Voidwalker cinematic helped reveal that multiple realities exist in Apex lore.
The Volt SMG existed in Titanfall before Apex Legends.
The Wingman looks like a revolver but is powerful enough to behave more like a precision weapon.
Titan technology continues to influence Apex lore even though players cannot pilot Titans.
Titans were tested during Apex Legends' development but were eventually removed.
Valkyrie is the daughter of Viper, one of the boss characters from Titanfall 2.
Valkyrie originally hated Kuben Blisk because she blamed him for her father's death.
Valkyrie's real name is Kairi Imahara.
Vantage grew up in extreme isolation with her mother.
Vantage learned survival skills long before she ever encountered normal society.
Vantage often misunderstands normal social behavior because of her isolated upbringing.
Vantage's companion is named Echo.
Voidwalker Wraith comes from a different dimension than the main Wraith.
Wall-running was also experimented with during Apex's development.
Wattson and Crypto developed an unusually close friendship despite Crypto's secretive personality.
Wattson grew up around the scientists and engineers who helped create the Apex Games.
Wattson has a particularly strong association with Nessie plushies.
Wattson helped design technology used to control the Ring.
World's Edge is located on the planet Talos.
Wraith can hear voices from alternate versions of herself warning her about danger.
Wraith has encountered alternate versions of herself.
Wraith was the first Legend to receive an Heirloom.
Wraith's abilities are tied to experiments involving phase technology.
Wraith's original Heirloom is a kunai.
Wraith's real name is Renee Blasey.
